what_this_is: A dated record of what the case-model journey's backends answered when they were read, and what that means for the journey's reach. The journey is: ask, scope, inspect, explain, propose, approve, fix, retest, receipt, monitor.
what_this_is_not: Not a claim that the journey works. Not a roadmap. A reading: the journey is reachable as far as the last backend that answered, and no further. Every row carries the endpoint it was read from, so a reader can re-run it.
how_to_read_it: Every availability is a fact about a response code, not a judgement. UNAVAILABLE means the endpoint answered 404 (it is absent). OWNER_GATED means it answered 402 or 503 (it exists and needs a payment or a key). VERIFIED means it answered 200. Re-probe with `LIVE_JOURNEY=1 node --test capabilities/journey-backends.test.mjs`.
measured_by: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://councilof.ai<endpoint>, read from the Mac on 2026-11-02

findings.reason: answered 200 with the regulation-findings corpus, its schema and its honesty block; it is the input the journey reads

receipts.reason: answered 200 with status PUBLISHED and count 26 aggregate items; the receipt ending of the journey EXISTS and is served

receipts_verify.reason: answered 200; a stranger can submit a receipt to the verifier without a session

ras.reason: answered 404 not_found; the case-model RAS endpoint is absent. NOTE: the RAS LANE is live under other paths - /api/ras/mcp-probe, /api/ras/x402-check and /api/ras/supply each answer 402 - so this row is about THIS endpoint only

ras_status.reason: answered 404 not_found; the case-model status endpoint is absent alongside /api/ras itself

remediation.reason: answered 404 not_found; there is no remediation runtime, so the fix half of the journey cannot be taken

jobs.reason: answered 404 not_found; there is no job runtime, so the retest half of the journey cannot be taken

ras_mcp_probe.reason: answered 402 Payment Required; the endpoint exists and is x402-metered, so it needs a payment rather than a key or a build

ras_x402_check.reason: answered 402 Payment Required; the endpoint exists and is x402-metered, so it needs a payment rather than a key or a build

ras_supply.reason: answered 402 Payment Required; the endpoint exists and is x402-metered, so it needs a payment rather than a key or a build

client_reference_note: No file under client/src references one of the UNAVAILABLE endpoints (/api/ras, /api/ras/status, /api/remediation, /api/jobs) by path. The catalogue does name /api/ras/supply, /api/ras/mcp-probe and /api/ras/x402-check, and those answer 402 - they are live, metered endpoints, not a 404 being offered as a working one.
consequence_for_wp3_and_wp6: The journey now reaches its receipt ending: ask and scope through /api/findings, and it can propose onward to a receipt that /api/receipts/latest publishes and /api/receipts/verify checks. It stops there. The approve/fix/retest middle has no runtime: /api/remediation and /api/jobs answer 404, so no surface may offer approve, fix or retest. When those land this record goes red on its own - that is the handoff signal, not a regression.
